summary: Crescent Private Credit Income Corp filed an 8-K on July 28, 2026, reporting its regular monthly distributions for Class I, S, and D common shares, net asset values as of June 30, 2026, and its continuous registered offering status. The filing discloses a monthly gross distribution of $0.165 per share (net of fees for certain classes), aggregate NAV of $552.2 million, portfolio fair value of $944.7 million, and outstanding debt of $418.8 million. The offering continues up to $3.0 billion of common shares. No special situation event is present; this is a routine periodic disclosure of operating metrics and a dividend declaration.
